theme_strategy.rationale: Real estate marketplaces demand high trust, clarity, and focus on photography. A light theme with deep navy and petrol blue accents conveys 'Old Money Tech' and established authority, matching the 'Esforço Notável Consultoria' brand.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#0d3b54]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#0d3b54]

rules: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Headings must use Playfair Display for a luxurious, editorial feel.
Body text and data-heavy components (like pricing, square meters) must use Manrope for crisp legibility.
All overlines and tiny labels must be uppercase with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use #1a5f7a (Petrol Blue) for primary interactive elements (Search CTA, Buy/Rent toggles).
Use #0d3b54 (Navy Blue) for deep structural elements, footers, and primary typography.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure gray. Always tint grays toward the brand blue (slate scale).
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Use text shadow over hero images if needed.
FORBIDDEN COLORS: Teal green (#1B93A4) and AI purple (#7351B7).

surfaces: Glassmorphism ('Crystal' Variant): For sticky header/nav. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a 1px border-b border-slate-200.
Cards: Flat white backgrounds (#ffffff) on off-white base (#f8fafc) with a delicate 1px border (border-slate-200) and NO default shadow. On hover, apply a subtle shadow-lg and -translate-y-1 lift.
Hero Overlay: bg-black/40 over the hero image to ensure the central search bar and white text have perfect contrast. Never exceed 50% opacity.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Subtle roundness. Use rounded-lg (8px) for buttons and inputs. Avoid overly pill-shaped elements for this professional brand unless it's a specific badge.

hero_search_bar.structure: A large central floating panel over the hero image. Use Shadcn Tabs for 'Comprar / Arrendar' (Buy/Rent). Inside the active tab, a responsive flex/grid row containing location Input, Property Type Select, Price Range Select, and a prominent search Button.
hero_search_bar.styling: bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20

property_card.structure: Image top (with aspect-video or aspect-[4/3]), content bottom. Include a 'Favorite' heart icon absolute positioned top-right on the image. Price in large Manrope font, title, location, and a row of icons/text for beds, baths, and area (m²).
property_card.styling: border border-slate-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 bg-white

property_details_split.structure: Left column (col-span-8): Masonry/grid gallery of large images, detailed description, map. Right column (col-span-4): Sticky container with price, key stats, and lead capture form (Contact Agent).
property_details_split.styling: Right column must use sticky top-24 to stay in view while scrolling photos.

admin_backoffice.structure: High-density grid. Sidebar navigation. Shadcn Data-tables for property lists. Forms with image upload zones.
admin_backoffice.styling: Strict grid, compact spacing, functional beauty. Use #f8fafc background, white cards, sharp edges.

general_rules: Use Shadcn components for all interactive logic (Select, Dialog, Tabs, Forms, Input).
Override Shadcn default styles to match the Playfair/Manrope typography and Petrol/Navy color scheme.
NEVER use native <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn equivalents.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: Use generous spacing (py-24, gap-12). Rely on bento-style grids for featured sections.
grids_and_layouts.listings_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Direct children only.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 with dense spacing (p-4, gap-4).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Mobile-first approach. Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content.

motion.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have transition-transform duration-200 ease-out. Cards lift (-translate-y-1).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for listing grids using simple CSS animation or framer-motion.
motion.rules: Disable animations if prefers-reduced-motion is active. Do not use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-search-button', data-testid='property-card-1').
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA/WCAG AA standards. Ensure hover states explicitly define text colors.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' on decorative icons. Ensure forms have visible labels.

rules: NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image URLs.
Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile.

hero_background.description: Modern white architecture under blue sky - creates aspirational real estate vibe

property_listing_2.description: Bright modern apartment interior living room

setup_steps: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Playfair Display and Manrope.
Initialize Shadcn UI and add components: button, input, select, tabs, card, dialog, table, form.
Implement Google Auth + Email/Password for the Backoffice login.
Implement a robust layout with a glassmorphic Navbar containing the 'Esforço Notável CONSULTORIA' text logo and a PT/EN language toggle.
development_phases: 1. Layout & Shell: Setup Navbar, Footer, and routing (Public vs Admin).
2. Hero & Search: Build the high-impact hero section with the complex search panel.
3. Marketplace: Build the property listings grid and the individual property detail split-panel page.
4. Admin Backoffice: Build the secure area to add/edit/delete properties with image URLs.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make it crisp and premium.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add specific transitions (e.g., transition-transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Left-align text for readability.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-lg, interaction animations).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent uses placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
